==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
In this world, I possess a magic pencil. Using this pencil, I draw into existence the equipment I need to become a superhero. I have my own super suit and vehicle that I created myself.

The only people who know my secret identity are my wife and daughter, who are also both superheroes. I don't think their names were ever said in the dream, and neither of them resembles anyone I know in the waking world. They both seemed to be very supportive of my career as a superhero.

The magic pencil can be used to create anything. I don't have to buy or pay for anything to support my family. This allows us to focus all of our efforts on fighting crime and having fun.
